# Blog Volt — Full Documentation

## Overview

Blog Volt is a bold, brutalist blog template built on the RaisFast platform. It delivers a high-energy reading experience with mono-spaced typography, thick borders, zero border radius, and all-caps headings — a no-nonsense design philosophy where form follows function.

## Architecture

### Rendering Strategy
- Server Components for data fetching (posts, categories, tags)
- Client Components for interactive UI (search)
- Dynamic rendering with `force-dynamic`

### Data Flow
```
Next.js Server Component
  → RaisFast SDK (lib/api.ts)
    → RaisFast Backend API (/api/v1/*)
      → SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL
```

## Pages

### Home Page (`/`)
- Featured post hero section
- Top 3 articles grid
- Remaining articles (2 columns)
- Load more button

### Post Detail (`/posts/[slug]`)
- Category badge
- Title, author, date
- Cover image
- HTML content with prose styling
- Tags
- Post navigation
- SEO: OG image, JSON-LD Article schema, canonical, Twitter Card

### Categories (`/categories`)
- Category listing page
- Link to category-specific post lists

### Category Posts (`/categories/[slug]`)
- Posts filtered by category
- Grid layout

### Tags (`/tags`)
- Tag listing page
- Link to tag-specific post lists

### Tag Posts (`/tags/[slug]`)
- Posts filtered by tag
- Grid layout

### About (`/about`)
- Static about page with brutalist design philosophy

### Search (`/search`)
- Full-text search with results grid

## Components

### Header (`components/header.tsx`)
- Site logo/name
- Navigation (Home, Categories, Tags, About)
- Mobile responsive

### Footer (`components/footer.tsx`)
- Site info
- Navigation links
- Copyright

### PostHero (`components/post-hero.tsx`)
- Large featured card for the latest post

### PostCard (`components/post-card.tsx`)
- Card with cover image, title, excerpt, date, category

### PostNav (`components/post-nav.tsx`)
- Previous/next post navigation

## SEO Implementation

### Meta Tags (all pages)
- `<title>` with template `%s — VOLT`
- `<meta name="description">`
- `<link rel="canonical">`
- Open Graph: title, description, url, image, type
- Twitter Card: summary_large_image

### JSON-LD (post pages)
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Article",
  "headline": "...",
  "description": "...",
  "image": "...",
  "datePublished": "...",
  "dateModified": "...",
  "author": { "@type": "Person", "name": "..." }
}
```

### Sitemap (`/sitemap.xml`)
- Dynamic generation from API data
- Includes: home, categories, tags, about, all posts

### Robots (`/robots.txt`)
- Allow all except /search, /api/
- Points to sitemap.xml

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` | RaisFast API base URL | `http://localhost:9898/api/v1` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Site URL for SEO | `https://example.com` |

## Deployment

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```
